name: list-utils
description: Essential collection and list helpers: hasItem, dedupeList, countMatches, joinWithPrefix, removeItemFromList, findFirstMatch, sortList, reverseList, calcListSum, and sliceList.

operations.name: hasItem
operations.description: Checks whether target exists inside the items list.

operations.name: dedupeList
operations.description: Returns a new list containing only the first occurrence of each distinct item.

operations.name: countMatches
operations.description: Counts how many elements in items equal target.

operations.name: joinWithPrefix
operations.description: Returns a new list with prefix prepended to every element of items.

operations.name: removeItemFromList
operations.description: Returns a new list with all elements equal to target removed.

operations.name: findFirstMatch
operations.description: Returns the first element matching target, or gone if not found.

operations.name: sortList
operations.description: Returns a sorted shallow copy of items without mutating the input list.

operations.name: reverseList
operations.description: Returns a reversed shallow copy of items without mutating the input list.

operations.name: calcListSum
operations.description: Computes the numeric sum of all elements in items.

operations.name: sliceList
operations.description: Returns a 1-based slice of up to countLimit elements starting at startIndex.
